testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/order-templates-validate-list-page-pagination-and-sorting.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Order Templates > validate list page pagination and sorting

scenario.summary: The signed-in user opens Order Templates, sorts by template name and by quantity both ways (first-row anchors plus monotonic order), checks the page-size options, shows all templates on one page and checks the total, checks the previous-page arrow is disabled, and searches a template to check its created and modified dates are MM/DD/YY.
steps: Sort Template Name ascending / descending: first-row name (and quantity) anchors; names monotonic
Sort Quantity ascending / descending: first-row quantity anchors; quantities monotonic
Page-size options 8/12/16/32/64; page size 12: row count equals totalTemplateCount
Search a template by name: created and modified dates in MM/DD/YY
stateChanges: None: the account's templates are only read
assertions: At least one template; first-row anchors after each sort; monotonic order
Page-size options; all templates on one page of pageSizeToApply equal totalTemplateCount (12)
Searched template row shows created/modified dates in MM/DD/YY
evidence: Title 'validate list page pagination and sorting' matches the flow; no linked AIO cases; all data through loadData (spec line 20)

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts AUTH_SPECS = my-account/**) on the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, which signs in with getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, process.env / .env.<env>). The migrated test declares that same account at test start: await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username). The credential source points at that env var (no value stored). Caveat: all 20 webstore-auth specs share this one account; declaring it leases it per test, so tests that declare it run one at a time (leaseWaitMinutes 10) - reviewer to confirm that serialisation is wanted (it also prevents the template/order count collisions noted here)

OWNERSHIP + SHAPE: everything read is the signed-in account's order templates (ZnodeOrder with ClassCode OrderTemplates). Data shape: at least 2 templates with different names and quantities, at most pageSizeToApply (12) so all fit one page; the recorded set had exactly 12

MISSING KEY: proposed ORDER_TEMPLATE_OF_USER (entity order, ClassCode OrderTemplates: params owner (link @user.userId), store, minTemplates, maxTemplates optional; outputs templateName, quantity, templateCount). With it: CreatedAndModifiedDateTemplateName -> templateName, totalTemplateCount -> templateCount, and pageSizeToApply must be >= templateCount (a page-size option). Until then template names, quantities and the count are recorded as expected-output only because a data source needs a declared alias

SORT ANCHORS (AscendingTemplate, DescendingTemplate, DefaultTemplateQuantity, Ascending/DescendingTemplateQuantity) are first rows over all the account's templates: no key can express them; proposal: the migrated spec keeps the monotonic checks and drops or derives the anchors
Collision risk: order-template-validate-quantity-and-total creates and deletes templates on the same account while this test counts them
migrate: values depend on the account's templates (and a swapped spec never declares an account)

Re-mapped to new keys (2026-11-01): template = ORDER_TEMPLATE_OF_USER (owner @user.userId, minTemplates 2 so a sort can be seen, maxTemplates 12 = pageSizeToApply so every template shows on that page and the previous arrow is disabled, store): totalTemplateCount -> templateCount, CreatedAndModifiedDateTemplateName -> templateName. LEFT AS expected-output: the sort anchors AscendingTemplate, DescendingTemplate, DefaultTemplateQuantity, Ascending/DescendingTemplateQuantity - the key outputs no first-row anchors (propose anchor outputs on ORDER_TEMPLATE_OF_USER, or have the migrated spec rely on its sortedness checks). pageSizeOptions are fixed UI. Strategy migrate
